rules.applies_when: a part is selected replaced or reviewed
actions: verify ratings pins polarity package and lifecycle
compare approved alternatives
record derating source
acceptance: symbol pin package pin and datasheet pin agree
maximum project stress plus required margin does not exceed applicable rating
rules.failure_policy: mark part unresolved and block manufacture

rules.applies_when: a rail is created changed or reviewed
required_inputs: per-load steady peak dynamic and external current
transient step duration and allowed droop
actions: calculate I_rail_max as the sum of worst-case loads without treating unknown as zero
for linear regulation calculate Ploss=(Vin_max-Vout_min)*Iout_max+Piq and Tj=Ta_max+Ploss*theta_effective
calculate ideal transient capacitance at least Istep*dt/dV then derate for bias temperature tolerance ESR and ESL
verify startup shutdown fault protection and reverse-current paths
required_evidence: per-load table and calculations with units/source pages
voltage current ripple and temperature measurement plan/result
acceptance: worst-case load is within every path component and source limit with project-approved margin
dropout transient and effective capacitance limits hold over the stated range
calculated and measured junction/board temperature remains within project limits or is explicitly NOT_RUN
rules.failure_policy: block design approval when any required load limit source or thermal-model applicability is unknown

rules.applies_when: clock or reset behavior affects boot
required_inputs: reset thresholds widths and power sequence
actions: verify component values and layout requirements
trace reset sources and default states
define brownout and debug behavior
acceptance: clock network values derive from selected component source
minimum reset pulse and voltage sequence meet every connected device
unsafe output defaults are defined during reset
rules.failure_policy: hold hardware/software integration on unknown boot condition

required_inputs: VIH_min VIL_max VOH_min VOL_max over supply temperature and load
actions: calculate NMH=VOH_min-VIH_min and NML=VIL_max-VOL_max for every direction
separately check recommended and absolute-maximum limits
select pull termination level shift or isolation
check back-power and contention
required_evidence: noise-margin calculations with datasheet source pages
powered-off and timing or signal-integrity evidence
acceptance: NMH and NML meet the project-source requirement in every legal direction
no state violates absolute maximum or causes uncontrolled back-power
direction and default level match software contract
rules.failure_policy: mark interface CONFLICT and block connection release on negative/unknown margin or unknown powered-off state

rules.applies_when: an analog quantity is measured or conditioned
actions: build worst-case error budget
verify settling and ADC drive requirements
check clipping common-mode and fault current
define calibration inputs
acceptance: full valid input range remains inside every stage limits
total stated worst-case error is within project requirement
missing contributor yields UNKNOWN rather than PASS
rules.failure_policy: block accuracy claim; preserve safe protection review

rules.applies_when: native schematic is reviewed or changed
actions: run actual ERC
classify each violation
reopen saved native project
compare network/BOM/pin diff
acceptance: every waiver has reason owner scope and revision
saved project reopens and retains intended objects
rules.failure_policy: report NOT_RUN when tool unavailable and block tool-verified claim
